item.title: Said & Checked, Kentucky, 2026-11-20: none false or contradicted, 1 unsupported, 9 unsettled (Thomas Massie)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsupported and Unsettled

  • Thomas Massie, U.S. Representative: “I have never said that to anybody that I am trying to cause chaos on the way out.” Unsupported. No record was found of Massie saying he is trying to cause chaos on his way out; the search covered web searches on the phrase and the Congressional Record, where he attributes the description to Speaker Johnson. An Axios article on the subject refused the fetch.
  • Thomas Massie, U.S. Representative: “Last Congress, we spent over 1 month in recess as we waited for one Representative to be sworn in.” Unsettled. AskAmerica's roll-call records show no House roll calls between Sept. 19 and Nov. 12, 2025, and NPR reported that Rep. Adelita Grijalva waited 50 days to be sworn in on Nov. 12, 2025. The delay is confirmed, but it occurred in the current 119th Congress, not the last one.
  • Thomas Massie, U.S. Representative: “we now know there were over 3 million files” Unsettled. The Justice Department's Jan. 30, 2026 release says it published over 3 million additional pages, for a total production of nearly 3.5 million pages, plus more than 2,000 videos and 180,000 images. The count is of pages, not files, so the figure matches only if files is read loosely as pages.
